title: Stanford Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Stanford Taiwanese Student Association (STSA) is a non-political, non-religious, and non-profit voluntary student organization serving the community of Taiwanese students and staff at Stanford University. The organization is listed as an affiliate of Stanford’s Asian American Activities Center (A³C) and primarily serves graduate students and staff from Taiwan, helping newcomers acclimate to academic and social life at Stanford.

STSA hosts a range of community events throughout the year, including a traditional Mid-Autumn Festival barbecue, Lunar New Year celebrations with spring couplet writing and Mahjong, group hikes, and an annual “Big Game” competition against the Taiwanese Student Association at UC Berkeley. The organization also maintains a student handbook (available via Gitbook) to orient incoming Taiwanese students to life at Stanford.
